headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; discussed possible budget cuts for fiscal year 2028.
summary: The principal assessor discussed the October 7, 2026 department head meeting. Officials reviewed the Department of Revenue's approval of growth and values. They started discussing what cuts, if any, may be needed in the fiscal year 2028 budget.
decisions: Approved the open session and executive session minutes of October 6, 2026, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session meeting minutes of October 6, 2026

plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – October 13, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of October 6, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Principal Assessor discussed the Department Head Meeting of October 7, 2026
The Board reviewed the approval of growth and values by the Department of Revenue
The Board started to discuss the budget for fiscal year 2028 and what if any cuts will need to be made
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
4. Adjourned Open Session @ 5:45 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:45 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
